results.title: Going On Strike
results.overview: A dancefilm celebrating solidarity in protest and the strength of a group in revolt.

results.title: Catalyst
results.overview: Seven men are abducted and held by mysterious masked captors. As the mystery behind their captivity unfolds, they must decide their path: choose one of them to die, or take the leap of faith there may be another way out to save them all.

results.title: People's Child
results.overview: After growing up in an orphanage, Abolfazl embarks on a journey to find his real mother. His path leads him through friendship, love, loss, and war—until he discovers where he truly belongs.

results.title: Vick & Tarstar's Scarecrow Factory
results.overview: Vick and Tarstar are shooting their latest horror movie trash epic, Scarecrowed, with a cast and crew of punks, drug addicts, fetish models, and dumpster divers. Set back with extra hairy relationship drama, homelessness, lack of funding, and their crew members quitting, Vick and Tarstar just want to tell their story: With the right bucket, you too can buy your own hair cutting scarecrow made by the animatronic Goo Guys at the Scarecrow Factory.

results.title: Date at Your Own Risk
results.overview: Eva is part of an online community where women can openly share stories of their negative dating experiences with specific men in order to warn others. Eva finds a post about her ex-fiance Will and confronts him.

results.title: Naale Rajaa Koli Majaa
results.overview: On the day of Gandhi Jayanti, when meat sale is prohibited nationwide, an 11-year-old girl goes on a quirky adventure in pursuit of a forbidden chicken curry.

results.title: Mint in Box
results.overview: Abby awakens to find herself trapped inside a crate, with unknown figures outside and her only hope is to find a means of  escape.

results.title: ACA 197: Ibragimov vs. Magomedov
results.overview: ACA 197: Ibragimov vs. Magomedov was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Friday, December  5, 2025 at the Irina Viner Usmanova Gymnastics Palace in Moscow, Russia.

results.title: Newport and the Great Folk Dream
results.original_title: Newport and the Great Folk Dream
results.overview: Powerful music leaps from the air and can change the actual world. At the Newport Folk Festivals in the early 1960s, the molecules were electric with rebellion and democracy, with anger and hope. Musicians drove that change — Bob Dylan, Joan Baez and Pete Seeger but also banjo players from coal country, remote Georgia gospel artists, rural Canadian fishermen, and the opportunities created for the urban kids to mingle with those they’d not ordinarily encounter.

results.title: INERTIA
results.overview: Caught between a troubled past and an uncertain future, a boy with strange powers learns growing up is about finding who you are, not what you can do.

results.title: Curandero
results.overview: Manuel is desperate to save his wife from death. A mysterious man appears to him one day at church, convincing him to go to a Healer who can help her.

results.title: Ghosting Mother
results.overview: Starting from the destroyed grave of my mother, a search begins for the remaining apparitions. A mourning ceremony, a movement of remembrance, attempts at resuscitation. ghosting mother works with methods of autofiction and deals with questions of mourning and its ritualization in bourgeois catholic contexts in an experimental documentary form.

results.title: Maudits
results.overview: In the eighth month of her pregnancy, which she is struggling to fully accept, Lucile discovers that her paternal grandmother is not dead, as she had always been told, but is alive and well in a small village in the Morvan region. Does this secret hide a terrible curse that would strike all the boys in the family and threaten Lucile's child? Or does it hide other family secrets? Against the advice of her loved ones, Lucile leaves for Morvan, determined to face the ghosts of her past...

results.title: The Tiny Shoe
results.overview: A baby apple tree elf is born, but the father hasn't had time to prepare a crib. He sets off to find one and ends up bringing little girl Lily's shoe home. Does the baby like this crib? Will Lili be able to get her shoe back?

results.title: Stan the Man
results.overview: From coaching football in the Pros to living on the streets. Stan must choose to face his demons and beat his addiction if he is to turn his life around and take a small Christian High School to its first ever state football championship.

results.title: Dog and Wolf
results.overview: Rudo is a 25-year-old stripper who has chosen to embrace a life of perpetual partying and sleep deprivation. As he navigates through the chaotic nightlife fueled by drugs and dance, memories of his ex-girlfriend Misha haunt him, reminding him of broken promises and lost connections.

results.title: Condition
results.overview: Seda, a family doctor in a rural town in the middle of Anatolia, goes to work on a regular Friday, but trying to do her duties right in front of some patients, comes at a price.

results.title: Zmęczone
results.overview: ‘Zmęczone’ is a comedy drama about three female employees of the administration, promotion and education department of a provincial theatre, who decide to write and stage a play in protest against the mobbing they experience from the incompetent artistic management.
